Prefix matching lets a sibling directory escape the run boundary, e.g. `../run-folder-evil/x` resolves outside `run_folder` yet `str(resolved).startswith(str(run_resolved))` returns `True`.

```suggestion
    if not resolved.is_relative_to(run_resolved):
```

`Path.is_relative_to` is available on the project's Python 3.13 (3.9+).

+    Parameters

+    command:
